measurementMethod.limitation: No browser-automation tool available; substituted a thorough static+dynamic code investigation and a reproduction test harness (vitest, real PeFactSheetResolver, real fixture-derived facets payloads). This is a genuine code-level measurement, not the live browser session R-4 calls for -- flagged, not hidden.

mechanismConfirmed.name: cache-outlives-its-inputs
mechanismConfirmed.statement: PeFactSheetResolver.resolve() is the one shared read path for every entry point, keyed by parcelNodeId with no TTL and no eviction on success -- only on a rejected promise. A parcel whose atom chain has not resolved yet is not a rejection: the server answers HTTP 200 with envelope.declineReason:'atom_path_pending' (the documented Gate C bounce). That pending seal was cached forever, freezing whichever entry point happened to see it first.
mechanismConfirmed.crossValidatedAgainst: P-152 lane 3 (#393, merged mid-session) independently found the server-side half of the same defect class: applyRecordPatch's failure branch explicitly leaves zoning/envelope untouched on a /record outage, named not silently fixed. Two lanes converged on one root cause from opposite directions without coordinating.

mechanismRejected.name: search-landing skips the live-envelope augmentation
mechanismRejected.statement: setbacksFact reads facets.envelope.setbacks from the raw un-augmented facets, never from augmentFacetsWithLiveEnvelope's output, which only ever touches geometry/buildableArea (P-153's row), never setbacks. Rejected with a passing regression test comparing a weak search hint against a rich click hint on an identical fixture.
mechanismRejected.secondaryCandidateAlsoConsidered: A parcelNodeId dual-grammar mismatch between situs-index-derived and PMTiles-derived ids -- not proven false with a live trace; left as an open item.

falsifier: If, after this lane's deploy, a search for 1109 PECAN ST lands on a card without the setbacks row while a click on the same parcel shows it, the row is not done.
